about_the_game:
Inspired by the beloved Lemonade Tycoon, Business Heroes: Street Grub is a turn-based strategy game where you're the mastermind behind your very own food truck empire. From crafting mouthwatering burgers to managing supplies and navigating customer feedback—your decisions determine your path from a humble food truck to a business magnate.

Single Player

  • Career Mode: Dive into the day-to-day excitement of running your food truck, facing all the challenges and rewards that come with business ownership.

  • Sandbox Mode: Flex your creative muscles and explore various strategies without limits.

  • Daily Challenge Mode: Test your skills against unique daily scenarios to maximize profits under varying conditions.

  • Time Challenge Mode: Compete to set record valuations and climb to the top of the leaderboards.

Multiplayer

Compete against up to 5 friends in epic 30-day challenges. Outsell and outsmart your competitors to dominate the market.

Key Features

  • Economic Simulation: Keep an eye on city-wide economics, adapting your strategy to respond to market fluctuations.

  • Business Management: Optimize inventory, ensure staff satisfaction, and make crucial financial decisions to advance your business.

  • Dynamic Market Conditions: Tackle unforeseen events like disasters and economic shifts that can impact your strategy.

  • In-depth Financial Reports: Utilize detailed reports to guide your decisions, ensuring every move is informed.

  • Global Expansion: Spread your culinary empire across 15 capital cities, each with unique market conditions and currencies.

  • Realistic Economics: Navigate through real-world pricing and currency values, tailored to each city you operate in.

  • Diverse Scenarios: No two playthroughs are the same, offering fresh challenges and opportunities to adapt and grow.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS High Sierra 10.13, Mojave 10.14, Catalina 10.15 or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 (native) or Intel Core M dual-core (Rosetta 2 supported)
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple Silicon integrated GPU or Intel Iris Plus Graphics 640 (Metal capable)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 MB available space
  • Sound Card: CoreAudio-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Universal build optimised for Apple Silicon; runs on Intel via Rosetta 2.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1 (64-bit), Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: 4th-Generation Intel® Core™ i3 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel® HD Graphics 4000, Nvidia GT 640 or AMD Radeon HD 7750 (DirectX 11 compatible)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible integrated or dedicated card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse required. 1080p display recommended.

short_description: Drawing on the spirit of the classic Lemonade Tycoon. Master the art of a street food business. Design mouth-watering recipes, strategically set prices, and manage inventory to prepare for the rush. Dive deep into analytics to optimize operations and tackle complex scenarios to test yourself.

Simplified Chinese, English*, Arabic
